title: Bootstrap deterministic multi-agent foundation
description: Bootstrap the first deterministic multi-agent foundation after Spec v3.1 freeze: Project Map Builder, Workflow/State Controller, invariant tests, governance evidence, and canonical verification integration.

why_medium: The pnpm verify change is additive: a new gate is inserted and no existing gate is removed or weakened.
No protected commerce domain, migration, OpenAPI contract, authorization, pricing, payment, inventory, finance, or destructive behavior is changed.
The implementation is isolated to the multi-agent bootstrap/governance surface and package verification wiring.
Rollback is straightforward: revert the additive package verification wiring and associated bootstrap files in a dedicated rollback task.
why_not_high: Spec v3.1 does not classify additive CI wiring alone as a protected HIGH domain.
The change does not alter business or financial truth and does not perform an irreversible mutation.
The current external branch-protection drift is handled as an independent blocking governance condition, not by silently inflating task risk.

acceptance_criteria.description: Project Map Builder deterministically generates .eqcofe/project-map.json from repository state.
Workflow Controller enforces frozen state transitions and terminal immutability invariants.
Multi-agent foundation gate is included in canonical pnpm verify without removing existing verification gates.
No forbidden sensitive-domain, migration, OpenAPI, or Step 57 product-design files are changed.
Required main-branch protection is active before merge eligibility is declared.

bootstrap.reason: Scope/Lock Controller, deterministic Verification Policy, and Protection Drift Monitor do not exist at the start of the first implementation task.

service_dependency.note: The services are not direct code dependencies. They are intentionally delivered in one bootstrap task because a fresh Project Map is a prerequisite to future dispatch, while Workflow/State control is the next required deterministic enforcement layer before normal task orchestration can start.

rollback_semantics.project_map_builder_revert: A rollback task must validate Workflow/State Controller behavior against the resulting map availability and compatibility. If safe independent operation cannot be proven, both services must be reverted in the same rollback task.
rollback_semantics.workflow_controller_revert: Project Map Builder may remain if independent validation passes because Workflow/State Controller does not own map generation.
rollback_semantics.rule: Every rollback uses a new task_id and explicitly names the service or services being reverted.

manual_lock.rule: No overlapping bootstrap implementation may modify this write scope until PR #164 is merged or aborted.

verification_policy.lint: NOT_CONFIGURED_IN_CANONICAL_PACKAGE; not invented as a bootstrap requirement

self_referential_ci.rule: The PR tests its own additive multi-agent verification gate.
self_referential_ci.on_failure: CI=FAIL; merge forbidden; repair within the same PR; retry_count increments; exact new head must be reverified.

verification_policy.gate_order_rationale: multi-agent:verify is placed before build because it is a lightweight deterministic repository/governance check that can fail earlier than TypeScript build, while all pre-existing gates remain intact.
verification_policy.replacement_end: Deterministic Verification Policy becomes authoritative after its implementation task is merged.

protection_drift_monitor.planned_stage: Frozen implementation order item 6 — Merge Policy / protection validation
protection_drift_monitor.pre_merge_until_then: Manual GitHub protection/status evidence plus CI status must be checked; NOT_VERIFIED never equals PASS.
protection_drift_monitor.merge_effect: BLOCKED until required main protection is enabled and reverified. Owner attestation must not be fabricated; GitHub evidence must show protection active before merge eligibility.
